VBO:0200574.summary: Steady, balanced character underpins German pointers’ versatile hunting work. The Shorthaired and Wirehaired breeds are described as firm and self-controlled, while the Longhaired is calm, good-natured and easily trained. Longhaired and Wirehaired Pointers work in fields, woodland and water before and after the shot; the separately standardized Roughhaired Pointer is also an even-tempered working gundog.
VBO:0200574.shortDescription: A group of steady, versatile pointing dogs, with distinct Shorthaired, Wirehaired, Longhaired and Roughhaired breeds.
